0f1894e3e20651.en: Key takeaways. Key takeaways. Let's recap the main points. Learning from Examples. Machine learning builds models that improve on tasks by finding patterns in data instead of hand-coded rules. Supervised learning uses labeled examples; unsupervised learning finds structure without labels. Reinforcement learning learns from rewards in environments like games. Data Splits. Data is split into training, validation, and test sets to measure generalization. Leakage—test information in training—_inflates scores misleadingly. Cross-validation gives robust estimates on smaller datasets. Features and Models. Features are inputs; labels are targets in classification and regression. Linear models are interpretable baselines; tree ensembles handle tabular data well. Neural networks excel on images, audio, and text with enough data and compute. Training Loop. Loss functions measure error; optimizers like Adam adjust weights to reduce loss over epochs. Batch size and learning rate affect stability and speed. GPUs accelerate matrix operations training large models. Overfitting. Models that memorize training noise fail on new data. Regularization, dropout, and early stopping reduce overfitting. More diverse data often helps more than endlessly bigger models. Evaluation. Classification uses precision, recall, and F1 especially when classes are imbalanced. Regression uses MAE and RMSE. Choose metrics aligned with real costs of false positives and false negatives. Deployment. Models serve predictions via APIs or on-device inference. Monitoring detects data drift when real-world inputs change. MLOps practices version data, code, and models for reproducibility. Limits and Ethics. Models can be biased, brittle on edge cases, and opaque in deep networks. High-stakes uses in medicine and justice demand oversight and transparency. ML augments human judgment; it does not replace accountability. Keep these in mind, and you'll have a solid working grasp of Intro to Machine Learning. That's the end of this lesson — thanks for listening.
0f1894e3e20651.text: 主要 takeaways。主要 takeaways。我哋嚟總結主要嘅重點。從例子學習。機器學習建立模型，透過喺數據入面搵到規律嚟改善任務，而唔係用手寫規則。監督式學習用有標籤嘅例子；無監督式學習喺冇標籤嘅情況下搵結構。強化學習就喺遊戲咁嘅環境入面從獎勵學習。數據分割。數據會分割成訓練集、驗證集同測試集，用嚟量度泛化能力。洩漏 — 測試資訊出現在訓練入面 — 會誤導咁 inflate 分數。交叉驗證喺細啲嘅數據集上面畀到穩健嘅估計。特徵同模型。特徵係輸入；標籤就係分類同回歸入面嘅目標。線性模型係易解釋嘅 baseline；樹集成模型好適合處理表格數據。神經網絡喺有足夠數據同運算能力嘅時候，喺圖像、音頻同文字上面表現出色。訓練循環。損失函數量度誤差；優化器例如 Adam 會調整權重，喺每個 epoch 減少損失。批次大小同學習率會影響穩定性同速度。GPU 加速矩陣運算，幫到訓練大模型。過擬合。模型如果死記訓練入面嘅噪音，喺新數據上面就會失敗。正則化、dropout 同提早停止可以減少過擬合。更多元嘅數據通常比不斷增大模型仲有效。評估。分類用精確率、召回率同 F1，尤其當類別唔平衡嘅時候。回歸就用 MAE 同 RMSE。選擇同真實假陽性同假陰性成本對齊嘅指標。部署。模型透過 API 或者裝置上推斷嚟提供預測。監測可以喺真實世界輸入改變嘅時候偵測數據漂移。MLOps 做法會將數據、程式碼同模型版本化，方便重現。限制同倫理。模型可能有偏差、喺邊緣情況好脆弱，同埋深度網絡入面好難解釋。喺醫學同司法嘅高風險應用，就需要監管同透明度。機器學習係 augmentation 人類判斷；佢唔會取代問責。記住呢啲，你就會對機器學習入門有穩固嘅工作理解。呢一課就到此為止 — 多謝你聽。

1fd0f32a9cb92f.en: Data Splits. Data is split into training, validation, and test sets to measure generalization. Leakage—test information in training—_inflates scores misleadingly. Cross-validation gives robust estimates on smaller datasets.
1fd0f32a9cb92f.text: 數據分割。數據會分割成訓練集、驗證集同測試集，用嚟量度泛化能力。洩漏 — 測試資訊出現在訓練入面 — 會誤導咁 inflate 分數。交叉驗證喺細啲嘅數據集上面畀到穩健嘅估計。
